final: SELECT c.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation AS c2 JOIN sites AS s2 ON c2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) AS fraction FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL, c.zoneref LIMIT 10
